name: ar
label: Accounts Receivable
description: Full AR lifecycle — customers, invoices, payments, allocations, dunning, and aging

table_notes.ar_customer: Master customer record with credit profile, billing address, and dunning state. account_manager_id references a user in the host application's user table.
table_notes.ar_invoice: Invoice header covering all invoice types (invoice, credit note, debit note). balance_due = total_amount - paid_amount - write_off_amount. billing_reference_id links credit/debit notes back to the original invoice.
table_notes.ar_invoice_line: One line per invoiced item. Supports GL coding, project/cost-centre allocation, and per-line tax. line_amount = quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_percent/100) - discount_amount.
table_notes.ar_payment: Cash receipt record before allocation. status transitions: UNALLOCATED -> ALLOCATED | PARTIALLY_ALLOCATED | REVERSED.
table_notes.ar_payment_allocation: Many-to-many junction between payments and invoices. discount_taken records early-payment discount applied at allocation time.
table_notes.ar_dunning_run: Batch dunning execution record. One run per dunning level per date; child events record per-customer outcomes.
table_notes.ar_dunning_event: Per-customer (and optionally per-invoice) outcome within a dunning run. Captures delivery method, contact used, and promise-to-pay commitment.
table_notes.ar_aging_snapshot: Point-in-time aging bucket snapshot per customer. Computed nightly; drives dashboards and dunning triggers without hitting transactional tables.

short_description: Full AR lifecycle — customers, invoices, payments, allocations, dunning, and aging
long_description: Complete Accounts Receivable schema covering the full order-to-cash cycle. ar_customer holds the credit profile and dunning state. ar_invoice handles all document types (invoice, credit note, debit note) with self-referencing billing_reference_id for corrections. ar_payment and ar_payment_allocation implement a flexible cash application model supporting partial and split payments with early-payment discounts. ar_dunning_run and ar_dunning_event support multi-level dunning campaigns with per-customer promise-to-pay tracking. ar_aging_snapshot provides pre-computed aging buckets for dashboards and triggers without hitting transactional tables.
when_to_use: Use for any ERP, SaaS billing, or fintech platform that needs to manage customer credit, track outstanding receivables, apply payments, chase overdue accounts, and report aging. Pairs naturally with the GL (general ledger) and AP templates for a full double-entry bookkeeping setup.
